scientific_scope: Internal Poissonnier 2026 open-arena painted-trail response development estimation for the frozen P4-v1 hard absolute-detection-gated local Weber steering mechanism only. This authorization permits the frozen P4 response search only after this exact authorization is merged and effective on main, permanent main test/deploy is green on a commit containing the complete pinned estimator qualification chain, and a separate one-shot execution-precondition gate is frozen. It is not external validation, canonical locomotion promotion, P1/P2/P3 rescue or rerun, H2-H5 recombination, cross-apparatus validation, or reserved Y-maze validation.

authorized_frozen_execution.ungated_P3_structural_benchmark_rule: For each P4 Halton index 1..1999, reuse the exact same sigma_field_mm and kappa_trail_per_s coordinates but run the frozen src/p3.js ungated local-sector Weber mechanism. Add the exact canonical null as slot 2000. Rank P4 and ungated panels separately on the same frozen primary objective and common-random-number seeds. This is a structural comparator, not a P3 rerun, and P3 official result semantics remain inaccessible.
authorized_frozen_execution.primary_objective: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of the four squared pheromone-minus-DCM treatment-contrast errors: two primary observables x short/long path strata, with equal colony weighting.
authorized_frozen_execution.secondary_guard_rule: Post-selection only. On the independent final-check panel, absolute standardized P4 contrast error must be <=1.0 for each of four path x secondary components using the frozen n-1 reference sample-SD scaling.
authorized_frozen_execution.canonical_null_survival_guard: Selected P4 candidate must beat exact canonical null in at least 5 of 6 held-out LOCO folds and have strictly positive median relative held-out improvement versus exact null.
authorized_frozen_execution.structural_increment_survival_guard: Selected P4 candidate must beat the separately selected frozen ungated P3 structural benchmark in at least 5 of 6 held-out LOCO folds and have strictly positive median relative held-out improvement versus that benchmark.
authorized_frozen_execution.dual_survival_rule: Both held-out survival guards must pass. Failure of either closes P4-v1 response estimation without rescue or retuning.
authorized_frozen_execution.identifiability_rule: If dual survival passes: exact null must be outside the P4 near-best set; best all-data ungated P3 benchmark must lie outside the same P4 near-best tolerance; selected normalized sigma, kappa, and theta coordinates must each be at least 0.02 from an active bound; near-best normalized span must be <=0.60 for each parameter.
authorized_frozen_execution.final_increment_rule: On the independent final-check panel, selected P4 primary loss must be strictly lower than both selected ungated P3 benchmark primary loss and exact canonical-null primary loss.
authorized_frozen_execution.final_fit_rule: The all-102-row fit may occur only if both LOCO survival guards pass. It must reuse the same frozen candidate panels. The independent final-check panel may evaluate frozen promotion guards but may not trigger refitting, alternate candidates, changed bounds, changed seeds, or changed thresholds.

execution_firewall: Do not change sigma, kappa, or theta bounds/scales, Halton mapping, candidate counts, ungated P3 comparator construction, trial counts, seeds, physics dt, objective construction, colony weighting, fold membership, secondary guards, identifiability thresholds, or promotion thresholds.
Do not add nuisance parameters or refit baseline locomotion, H2, H3, H4, or H5.

Do not use P4 sensor-sector diagnostics, raw L/R sector means, signal sum, detection state, Weber signal, steering omega, moving speed, moving distance, straightness, moving-time fraction, raw headings, or any forbidden observable for candidate ranking.
Do not pool pheromone-minus-DCM contrasts across path strata or weight colonies by ant-row count.
Do not introduce treatment-specific, path-specific, colony-specific, direction-specific, experience-specific, fold-specific, or threshold-specific response parameters.
Do not access, parse, or use P1, P2, or P3 official response-estimation result semantics for tuning, selection, ranking, or interpretation of the P4 search.
Use src/p3.js only as the pinned frozen structural ungated-Weber comparator at the exact projected P4 sigma/kappa coordinates under the P4 objective.
Do not access or use Y-maze data, outcomes, simulations, geometry, labels, or metrics for selection, fitting, ranking, or interpretation.
Do not change the frozen P4 mechanism, runtime, model structure, sensor geometry, hard detection gate, zero-epsilon Weber transduction, apparatus, canonical runtime, or canonical locomotion model.
Do not run an adaptive second-stage search, inject candidates, alter bounds, increase the budget, change seeds, or rerun with favorable seeds after seeing target-ranked outcomes.
Do not pass --candidates, --trials, --eval-trials, --seed, --final-trials, --final-seed, or --dt in high-resolution mode.
official_execution_rule: Authorize exactly one official execution of the frozen P4-v1 high-resolution response-estimation procedure after this authorization is merged and effective on main, permanent main test/deploy succeeds on a commit containing this exact authorization and all pinned qualification artifacts, and a separate one-shot execution-precondition record/workflow verifies those conditions. A rerun is permitted only if the first official attempt is formally declared invalid because of a genuine infrastructure or implementation error before a valid scientific result exists; any corrected attempt must rerun the entire frozen procedure unchanged.
post_result_rule: Freeze and record the complete P4 scientific result before any interpretation-driven code, policy, mechanism, model, or comparator change. Failure cannot be rescued by retuning P4-v1, changing the search, changing the ungated P3 comparator, weakening either survival guard, changing identifiability or secondary guards, or selecting a favorable rerun. If either dual survival guard fails, close P4-v1 response estimation. If dual survival passes but identifiability, final increment, or secondary guards fail, report the limited conclusion without promoting a fixed parameter triplet.
response_target_semantic_access_scope: Only through tools/run-p4-estimation.js in frozen highres mode after this exact authorization is effective on main and the separate execution-precondition gate verifies green permanent main CI.
P3_runtime_structural_comparator_scope: Only the pinned src/p3.js frozen ungated Weber mechanism under the separately ranked comparator panel defined by P4_response_estimation_v1.
